extension.summary: A Kodi client for Silo Media Server
extension.description: Independently maintained community client for browsing and playing media served by a Silo Server configured by the user.
extension.disclaimer: No media, streams, or subscriptions are included or supplied by this add-on. You must configure access to your own Silo Server. This is an independent community project; it is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or an official product of Silo Media L.L.C. or the Kodi Foundation.
extension.news:
V1.1.22 * Renamed to Kolo with a new add-on ID (plugin.video.kolo). Installs of the previous add-on do not update automatically: install Kolo from the repository, sign in again, then remove the old add-on
V1.1.21 * Add TMDB Box Set browsing and search, including collection artwork and per-film watched/resume state * Negotiate server-supported HLS subtitle renditions, including all available embedded text tracks * Retry safe API reads after HTTP 429 using bounded Retry-After-aware backoff
